name: nimbus
description: Connects Codex and ChatGPT to the Nimbus Platform by Lanzark: create apps, clone them, manage their environment variables and deploy them.

interface.longDescription: Lanzark Nimbus lets you create and ship internal web apps on the Nimbus Platform from a conversation. Create a new app from the Nimbus template, get a short-lived git credential to clone it, manage its environment variables, deploy it and follow the build. Sign in with your Nimbus account; every action runs with your own permissions inside your organization.
capabilities: Create Nimbus apps from the Nimbus template
List and inspect your Nimbus apps
Mint short-lived git credentials scoped to one app repository
Deploy apps and follow their deployments
defaultPrompt: Create a new Nimbus app for tracking team requests
Deploy my Nimbus app and tell me when the build finishes

positive.description: Identify the signed-in user and their organization
positive.prompt: Which Nimbus account and organization am I using?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's name, email and active organization.
Lists the test account's sample apps, including demo-requests, with their names and status.

positive.prompt: Show me the details of my demo-requests app
positive.expected_behavior: Shows demo-requests' repository, URL and latest deployment.

positive.description: Set an environment variable on an app
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then confirms GREETING was saved for demo-requests without repeating its value. It applies on the next deploy.

positive.description: Deploy an app after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Deploy demo-requests and tell me when the build finishes
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a summary and asks whether to deploy. Only after the user says yes it starts the deployment and reports its status until the build finishes.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Nimbus should not be used
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Madrid today?

negative.description: General coding question with no Nimbus action
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between let and const in JavaScript

negative.description: Deployment to another platform: deploy_app should not run

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create Nimbus apps, mint git credentials, manage environment variables and deploy.
